_readme: Your switches. Safe defaults: nothing publishes, nothing spends. See growth/README.md.

publishing._killSwitch: true = ALL automated publishing is stopped. Set false only after you have approved the first campaign.
publishing._autoPublishRoutine: false = every item needs your approval in the review queue. true = items from already-approved series publish without asking.
publishing._account: Which of your accounts to post from (names only, never passwords).

workflows._paused: true = generate/publish/report all exit immediately (pause everything).

spend._aiMonthlyLimitUSD: 0 = AI copywriting is off (free templates are used). Raise it to e.g. 3 to allow Claude API calls.
spend._adsMonthlyLimitUSD: Paid advertising is never launched by these tools.

recurringCosts.name: Cloudflare Worker + D1 (analytics)
recurringCosts.note: Free tier: 100k requests/day, 5 GB D1. Paid plan only if you outgrow it ($5/mo).

recurringCosts.name: Claude API (optional copywriting)
recurringCosts.note: Off by default; capped by spend.aiMonthlyLimitUSD

recurringCosts.name: n8n (optional, self-hosted)
recurringCosts.note: Free self-hosted; your n8n Cloud plan is billed separately by n8n
